title: AgentTrust: issue and revoke an on-chain agent credential
summary: Issue a credential PDA for an agent, fetch it while it is valid, then revoke it and see AlreadyRevoked.
what: AgentTrust is an Anchor 1.1 program for a simple on-chain credential registry aimed at AI agents. An issuer writes a credential PDA seeded by the agent pubkey and a type string, can log it with get_credential, and can revoke it. The hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment; the IDL was hand-derived from source and confirmed by live transactions.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agenttrust/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agenttrust/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare.
try_steps.see: The page lists issue_credential, get_credential and revoke_credential, and shows program 2XxFdCMo…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: issue_credential type campus-scout is already taken for the lab wallet as agent. Fetch credential 9QXpx6HL… (seeds ["credential", agent, type]).
try_steps.see: revoked=true after the lab revoke. get_credential or a second revoke should fail with AlreadyRevoked.

diagram: issuer --issue_credential--> credential PDA ["credential", agent, type] ; issuer --revoke_credential--> same PDA (revoked=true)
innovation: A minimal on-chain credential that an agent can present and an issuer can revoke.
exercises: Fetch the lab credential and confirm revoked=true.
Explain why a 33-byte type fails before the program error.
not_covered: UnauthorizedRevoke was not exercised (needs a second wallet).
build: Anchor 1.1.2 program, declared at 2XxFdCMo3fKPHKLgvbyatMoWBteCcELkv9SDC2VYqBAe on devnet. IDL hand-derived and tx-confirmed.
